t_raise: Hermanos, everyone, a question, and nobody goes to sleep until they answer: {topic}
Okay, hermanos, while the fire's still good, and I'm watching it: {topic}
cristobal_knight.t_react_warm: Que lindo, {name}, that's a good one, it went right to my chest.
cristobal_knight.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, hombre, I'm dying, nothing funnier all month!
cristobal_knight.t_react_tease: That's all you've got, {name}? Weak, hermano, very weak, like a fire with wet wood.
cristobal_knight.t_react_same: {name}, that's mine, you stole my answer, we're brothers now whether you like it or not.
cristobal_knight.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, your turn, don't make me drag it out of you.
cristobal_knight.t_guess_player: {player} won't say, look at that face, hermanos. Something very bad or very good, I'd bet my boots.
cristobal_knight.topic_miss_most: The hills of Valparaiso at night, hermanos, all the little houses lit up in every colour, and the port down below, and everybody shouting across the stairs.
cristobal_knight.topic_first_night: Up a hill, naturally, watching for smoke. I didn't trust the sky here, and I still don't, a little.
cristobal_knight.topic_worst_shift: The day a whole cookout of tourists lit a barbecue in the dry season, in the wind, and acted surprised. Six hours, and I lost my eyebrows.
cristobal_knight.topic_last_meal: Chorrillana from a bar near the port, the big plate of fries and meat and onions and eggs, for four people, eaten by me.
cristobal_knight.topic_useless_skill: My nose knows which way the wind will turn an hour from now. Here it smells of magic and sheep, so I'm guessing.
cristobal_knight.topic_here_better: The parties, hermanos, nobody here goes to bed early. Every inn is a fiesta if you push it a little.
cristobal_knight.topic_kid_trouble: I set off a whole box of fireworks in the school bathroom at eleven. That's when they said, this boy, put him with the firemen.
cristobal_knight.topic_settle_down: Somewhere on a hill above the sea, hermanos, with neighbours who dance and a fire I'm allowed to keep.

t_raise: Right, mate, everyone, question for the fire, no wriggling out of it: {topic}
Here's one, everybody, and I want proper answers, not mumbles: {topic}
callum_venomancer.t_react_warm: Aw, {name}, that's a beauty, mate, that's genuinely lovely.
callum_venomancer.t_react_laugh: Strewth, {name}, I'm in bits, that's the funniest thing I've heard since the crocodile with the hat.
callum_venomancer.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Mate, I've had more personality out of a blue tongue lizard in winter.
callum_venomancer.t_react_same: No way, {name}, same here, exactly, that's spooky, mate.
callum_venomancer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Go on, mate, out with it, I don't bite, mostly.
callum_venomancer.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone quiet as a carpet python, mate. Something good's in there, I can feel it.
callum_venomancer.topic_miss_most: A storm rolling over Brisbane in the afternoon, mate, the whole sky going green, the frogs going mad, and the smell of rain on hot concrete.
callum_venomancer.topic_first_night: In a hollow log, which I checked first, obviously, mate. Shared it with a very surprised lizard, and we got on fine.
callum_venomancer.topic_worst_shift: A school group, thirty kids, and somebody left the crocodile enclosure gate open a crack. Nobody got hurt, but I aged ten years.
callum_venomancer.topic_last_meal: A meat pie from a servo with tomato sauce, a lamington, and a cold one on a verandah while it rains. Proper Aussie fine dining.
callum_venomancer.topic_useless_skill: I can catch a snake by the tail without looking. Here the snakes have wings sometimes, so that's not as useful as you'd hope.
callum_venomancer.topic_here_better: The animals, mate, obviously, every single one is something nobody's ever written down. I'm in heaven, mostly.
callum_venomancer.topic_kid_trouble: I brought a red bellied black snake to show and tell at nine. The teacher climbed on the desk, and I got a week of detention.
callum_venomancer.topic_settle_down: Somewhere warm, with a big verandah and too many animals. Nobody else needs to like it, mate.

t_raise: My friends, I raise a question, like a cup. Answer it: {topic}
A question, my friends, for the fire, and slowly: {topic}
giorgi_primalist.t_react_warm: This is good, {name}. A true answer, like bread.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, very good, I laugh like at a supra after the fifth toast.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_tease: This is small, {name}, a small answer. A sheep would say more, and a sheep is not clever.
giorgi_primalist.t_react_same: {name}, this is my answer also. We drink to it, then.
giorgi_primalist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? You also answer. At my table everyone speaks.
giorgi_primalist.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet, my friends, like a mountain before the bells. We wait, it comes.
giorgi_primalist.topic_miss_most: Kazbegi in the morning, my friends, the big mountain clean against the sky, the church on the hill, and the bells of the sheep coming up the path.
giorgi_primalist.topic_first_night: On a hillside, sleeping between rocks like a shepherd. Very cold, very quiet, and no sheep, which was strange.
giorgi_primalist.topic_worst_shift: A storm on the high pasture, the flock running, and I walked all night with a lamp to find the last eleven. I found ten.
giorgi_primalist.topic_last_meal: Khinkali, many, with black pepper, and khachapuri with the egg in the middle, and wine from a cousin, much wine.
giorgi_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can call my sheep by name, two hundred names. Here there are no sheep of mine, so I say the names to myself.
giorgi_primalist.topic_here_better: The mountains here are big also, my friends, and the people share their food. It is a little like home.
giorgi_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: I took my grandfather's horse up to the high pasture alone at ten, to prove something. I proved I was very bad with horses.
giorgi_primalist.topic_settle_down: High up, on a mountain, with a small house and a flock and a long table for guests. This is all.

t_raise: Righto, team, question for the fire, and everybody has a go: {topic}
Here's a good one, team, while the kettle's on: {topic}
liam_suncleric.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's a ripper, mate, really, that got me right in the chest.
liam_suncleric.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, stop it, I'm laughing so hard I'll need to check my own pupils.
liam_suncleric.t_react_tease: That's the best you've got, {name}? Mate, I've had more chat out of a patient under sedation.
liam_suncleric.t_react_same: Too right, {name}, same for me, exactly that, fair dinkum.
liam_suncleric.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Go on, mate, your turn, breathe out and say it.
liam_suncleric.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone quiet, team. Either a cracker of a story or a sad one. I'll bet the first.
liam_suncleric.topic_miss_most: Fog coming up the valley at Katoomba, team, rolling over the Three Sisters, and a pie and a hot coffee at the lookout.
liam_suncleric.topic_first_night: On a rock ledge, counting the breathing of a bloke I'd pulled out of a creek. He made it, and I didn't sleep, as usual.
liam_suncleric.topic_worst_shift: A tourist who went off the walking track in fog and phoned us from a cliff. Nine hours with ropes and a stretcher, and he complained about the food.
liam_suncleric.topic_last_meal: Snags in bread with onion off a barbie, a cold beer, and backyard cricket after with somebody's dog fielding.
liam_suncleric.topic_useless_skill: I can reverse an ambulance down a mountain road in the dark. Here there's no ambulance, so that's a lot of practice gone to waste.
liam_suncleric.topic_here_better: Wounds close when you ask them to, team. Seventeen years I'd have given anything for that, and here it is.
liam_suncleric.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my bike off the bottom of the escarpment track at twelve and broke my arm in two places. Mum set it before the ambos got there.
liam_suncleric.topic_settle_down: Up in some mountains with fog, team, a little house, a barbie out back, and a bed I actually sleep in.

t_raise: Ay, everybody, a question, and nobody leaves my chair without answering: {topic}
Mi gente, sit, sit, I have a good one for you: {topic}
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, mi amor, that's beautiful, you're making my eyes wet.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, papi, stop, I can't breathe, that's the best one!
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Mi amor, my chair heard better stories from men waiting for a shave.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_react_same: Same as me, {name}, the same! We should open a shop together, you and me.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, mi amor, now you. Sit in my chair and tell me everything.
orlando_witchdoctor.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, mi gente, a face like a customer who wants to tell me something and doesn't know how. I'll get it out.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_miss_most: My shop on a Saturday, mi gente, two chairs, a radio playing salsa, dominoes outside, and every man in the street telling me his business.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_first_night: In a field with my scissors in my pocket, giving myself a haircut by a stream so I'd feel like a person.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_worst_shift: A man came in for a trim on the morning of his wedding and fell asleep in the chair. His friends asked me to shave his eyebrows. I did one.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_last_meal: Mofongo with garlic shrimp, and tostones, and a cold Medalla on a balcony with the music up loud.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_useless_skill: I can give a perfect fade in nine minutes without a mirror. Here half the people have horns, papi, and the fade doesn't sit right.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_here_better: People here sit together and talk, mi gente, without looking at their phones. It's like my shop, all the time.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_kid_trouble: I cut my little cousin's hair at eight with the kitchen scissors, to practise. My aunt didn't talk to me for a week.
orlando_witchdoctor.topic_settle_down: A little shop with two chairs and a door that's always open, mi gente, somewhere with a lot of noise outside.

t_raise: Everyone, a question, and I'd like everybody to answer properly: {topic}
Squad, a question before we sleep, and nobody passes: {topic}
adrian_templar.t_react_warm: That's a good answer, {name}, a proper one. Thank you for it.
adrian_templar.t_react_laugh: Hostia, {name}, I'm laughing, and I'm not easily made to laugh.
adrian_templar.t_react_tease: That's your whole answer, {name}? In my old job that's what we called a dive.
adrian_templar.t_react_same: {name}, I'd have said the very same. Fair enough, we agree for once.
adrian_templar.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, please. Everyone else has answered fairly.
adrian_templar.t_guess_player: {player} is quiet, which I respect. But I'm keeping a note that they haven't answered.
adrian_templar.topic_miss_most: The walk out of the tunnel onto the pitch before a match, everyone, the noise of the stand hitting you like weather.
adrian_templar.topic_first_night: Under a tree outside Astranaar, with my whistle in my hand, waiting for somebody official to arrive. Nobody did, so I organised the supply tent.
adrian_templar.topic_worst_shift: A cup tie in a small town, ninety third minute, and a man climbed the fence to explain the offside law to me. Incorrectly, I might add.
adrian_templar.topic_last_meal: Lechazo, the roast lamb they do in Valladolid, with bread and a glass of Ribera, eaten slowly with good company.
adrian_templar.topic_useless_skill: I can run backwards at full speed for ninety minutes without falling over. It's surprisingly little use in a cave.
adrian_templar.topic_here_better: People here ask me to settle things, everyone, and they listen to the answer. At home they only shouted.
adrian_templar.topic_kid_trouble: I gave my whole class detention at nine while the teacher was out. I had a whistle and a list, and I meant it.
adrian_templar.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a flat field, everyone, so I can mark out a pitch. And a fire where somebody waves me over.

t_raise: Now then, everybody, a question, and I'll go last so I can hear yours: {topic}
Here's one for the fire, my lovely lot, if you're in the mood: {topic}
owen_cultist.t_react_warm: Oh, {name}, that's lovely, that is. I'll write it in the good part of the notebook.
owen_cultist.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, you've set me off now, I'll be laughing at that on watch.
owen_cultist.t_react_tease: That's it, bach? Thin as a motorway sandwich, {name}, and about as tasty.
owen_cultist.t_react_same: Same as mine, {name}, near enough. Funny old world, isn't it?
owen_cultist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, bach? Your turn now, over, I'm listening.
owen_cultist.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, everybody. Some of us are, mind, and that's all right.
owen_cultist.topic_miss_most: The radio phone ins at three in the morning on the M4, everybody, lonely people talking to other lonely people. I felt like I knew them.
owen_cultist.topic_first_night: In my cab, except the cab was gone, so in a field holding a handset with no cord. I talked into it all night anyway.
owen_cultist.topic_worst_shift: Stuck on the Severn Bridge in a gale for six hours with a load of frozen peas and a dead radio. Longest night of my life.
owen_cultist.topic_last_meal: A full breakfast at the services at Membury at five in the morning, everybody, beans, black pudding, and a tea you could stand a spoon in.
owen_cultist.topic_useless_skill: I can reverse a forty four tonne lorry into a gap with a foot either side. Here they mostly want me to reverse away from things.
owen_cultist.topic_here_better: Nobody's lonely here for long, everybody. Somebody always pulls up a seat, and I didn't have that before.
owen_cultist.topic_kid_trouble: I sang the wrong words to a hymn in chapel at nine, on purpose, very loudly. I still think it was funny.
owen_cultist.topic_settle_down: By the sea, somewhere with rain and a chapel and a chip shop. Barry, really, if Barry turned up.

t_raise: My friends, a question, and please, one at a time, no interrupting: {topic}
Beyler, a question for the fire, with coffee: {topic}
emre_rogue.t_react_warm: {name}, your answer turns smoothly, like a well made key.
emre_rogue.t_react_laugh: Ha, vallahi, {name}, you made a patient man laugh, and that's a rare thing.
emre_rogue.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? I've had longer conversations with a padlock.
emre_rogue.t_react_same: {name}, my answer exactly. Two keys, one lock, it seems.
emre_rogue.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, my friend, and nobody will interrupt you, I promise.
emre_rogue.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing, my friends. Even a closed door tells you something, if you listen.
emre_rogue.topic_miss_most: Simit from the cart and tea in a little glass on the ferry across the Bosphorus at dawn, my friends, the gulls screaming for crumbs.
emre_rogue.topic_first_night: In a ruin with a very good door, which I opened, naturally. Then I closed it again, and slept against it.
emre_rogue.topic_worst_shift: A jeweller locked himself in his own safe, my friends, during a heatwave, and his wife wasn't sure she wanted him out.
emre_rogue.topic_last_meal: Iskender kebab with the butter poured over at the table, yoghurt, and a Turkish coffee after, very strong.
emre_rogue.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you how old a lock is by its sound, within ten years. Nobody here asks, they just kick the door.
emre_rogue.topic_here_better: The doors here are very serious, my friends. Somebody built them meaning it, and I can read every one.
emre_rogue.topic_kid_trouble: I locked every door in my uncle's shop at nine, from the inside, and hid the keys. Then I forgot where.
emre_rogue.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with old doors and a cafe, my friends, and a young apprentice with quick hands and no patience.

t_raise: Everybody eat, and while you eat, answer me this: {topic}
A question for the fire, my people, and nobody answers on an empty stomach: {topic}
tarek_templar.t_react_warm: That's a beautiful answer, {name}. May your hands be safe, as we say.
tarek_templar.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's wonderful, I'm laughing into the soup now.
tarek_templar.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? You'd fail my first year engineering exam with an answer that thin.
tarek_templar.t_react_same: {name}, that's my answer too. Good, then we're built the same way.
tarek_templar.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, have you eaten? Good, then answer, it's your turn.
tarek_templar.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, my people. Maybe they're hungry, I'll feed them, and then they'll talk.
tarek_templar.topic_miss_most: The noise of Cairo at night, my people, everyone talking at once, cars, music, tea in the street, a city that never stops.
tarek_templar.topic_first_night: By a stream, checking the water by moonlight before I'd drink it. I was an engineer even then, scared out of my mind.
tarek_templar.topic_worst_shift: A main burst under a hospital in July, and we had six hours before they lost water. We did it in five, and I didn't sleep for two days.
tarek_templar.topic_last_meal: Koshari from the cart near my flat in Heliopolis, too much fried onion, too much sauce, eaten on the pavement.
tarek_templar.topic_useless_skill: I can calculate the pressure in a pipe in my head. Here they mostly want me to dig, which is honest work, but still.
tarek_templar.topic_here_better: Here, my people, the poison in the water is something you can see and fight. That's a luxury, believe me.
tarek_templar.topic_kid_trouble: I took apart the bathroom tap at ten to see how it worked, and the whole flat flooded. My first engineering lesson.
tarek_templar.topic_settle_down: Splintertree, maybe, by a well that's still standing in ten years. With a big table for whoever's hungry.

t_raise: Oe, causas, a question, everybody answers, no excuses: {topic}
Ya, causas, while we rest, one question, around the circle: {topic}
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_warm: Chevere, {name}, I like that one, really.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, pata, that's too much, I'm crying now.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Pata, a combi driver has more to say, and they only shout the route.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_react_same: {name}, causa, same answer as me! Two on the same bike.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_ask_player: Oe, {player}, your turn, pata. Tell us, we're all waiting.
nicolas_bloodmage.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, causas, but I've watched their colour all night, and it's good. They're fine, just thinking.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: Sunday ceviche in Comas, causas, the whole table talking at once, the grey sky over Lima, a cold Inca Kola.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_first_night: On the edge of a forest with my kit, checking every scratch on myself twice, because there was nobody else to check.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: A bus crash on the Panamericana at rush hour, eight patients, two bikes, and the traffic wouldn't move even for us.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: Ceviche with leche de tigre, very cold, very spicy, then lomo saltado, and a nap after.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can ride a motorbike between two buses with ten centimetres either side. No buses here, so I'm very slow now.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_here_better: Here I can stand in front, causas, and take the hits for everybody. On the bike I could only arrive after.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: My sisters dressed me up as a girl for a school party at eight, and I let them. I won the costume prize.
nicolas_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: Somewhere near a big road, causas, where people need help fast. And a kitchen big enough for a Sunday.
